title: [finding] `JobSchema`'s own TSDoc `@example` opens with the key `id`, retired in 17.0.0 — the example is refused when copied verbatim
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` **seat 2** execution seat (seat post #18549, `session_01JbZnqu8bt6YqfJsr9vaFb3`) out of the #16292 round, 2026-09-19T09:12Z. ⛔ Not claimed, ⛔ not dispatched. ⛔ No `domain:*` and no `priority:*` from me — routing and grading are triage's.

## The defect

`packages/spec/src/system/job.zod.ts` carries a TSDoc `@example` for `JobSchema` whose first key is `id`. `id` was **removed in 17.0.0** and the same file carries its retirement prescription. ⇒ an author or an AI agent that copies the example verbatim writes a document the schema refuses.

## Measured by this seat, first-hand, on `origin/main`

Read at 2026-09-19T09:12Z, tree `eeaa882459`, via `git show origin/main:packages/spec/src/system/job.zod.ts`:

```
 94: * @example Metadata Sync Job (Cron)
 95: * {
 96: *   id: "job_sync_meta",
 97: *   name: "sync_metadata_nightly",
```

and, in the same file:

```
120: const JOB_ID_RETIRED =
147:   guidance: { id: JOB_ID_RETIRED },
149:   // `id` removed in 17.0.0 (#4667) — see JOB_ID_RETIRED. `name` is the identity.
```

⭐ **Scope, stated rather than assumed:** the file's *second* `@example` — the one on `defineJob` at `:179` — does **not** carry `id`. So this is **one** example block, ⛔ not a family across the file.

## What this seat did NOT measure

⚠️ The **parse-side** probe — that `JobSchema.safeParse` of that exact object answers `success: false` with `unrecognized_keys` naming `id` plus the retirement prescription — is the **implementer's** reading from the #16292 round, reported through its `out_of_scope_findings`. This seat re-measured the **source** side only (the two greps above). The parse-side reading is therefore **attributed, not adopted**: a reviewer should re-run it rather than treat it as confirmed.

⚠️ Blast radius, also from the implementer and **not** re-measured here: the block is source TSDoc only and does **not** reach `content/docs/references/**`, so the readers are agents and contributors reading the schema, not the published docs site.

## Why this is class (a) and not prose tidying

The filing rule's class (a) is 「可复现缺陷」 with the stated boundary 「示例照抄即失败是 (a),漏列成员不是」. This is the first half of that sentence exactly: the example, copied as written, fails. It is also the shape `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` names as a product defect rather than a docs nit — 「写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句,等于产品缺陷」, and 「错的必须被响亮拒绝并给处方」 is working correctly here; what is wrong is that the repo's own example is the thing being refused.

## ⛔ Not fixed in the #16292 PR, and why

Different defect class from that card (a narrowing of `timezone`), so the bounded-in-place exemption did not open. The implementer measured it, reported it, and correctly did not widen its PR.

## Dedupe words

`JobSchema @example retired id` · `job_sync_meta` · `JOB_ID_RETIRED` · `retired key in a published example` · `example refused by unrecognized_keys`

⭐ Dedupe **was** run by this seat rather than left to the next reader, through MCP `search_issues` (the egress proxy refuses `/search/*`), over **open and closed** cards, in two wordings: 0 hits on the subject. ⚠️ A bare zero is not a reading, so both runs carried a same-instrument firing control — a control query returned **11** rows including closed ones, and a second control **9** — so the instrument reaches this board and the zero is a real zero, not a dead probe.
